integrity: The proof derives every right translation from the generalized Alexander formula, uses the source displacement-generation statement, and distinguishes the two finite groups by element order. An exhaustive independent finite-group replay verifies all 56 quandle elements and both 336-element groups.
scientific_limitations: The result identifies the inner automorphism group of P7 and separates it from the geometric orbit group in the cited fibred realization. It does not compute the full automorphism group Aut(P7) and does not alter the source classification of realizations.
title: The inner symmetry group of the prism quandle is not its orbit group
